PHYSICS / 01

Projectile
Motion

An interactive 3D simulation of projectile motion and dynamics.

Instructions

GRAVITY   9.82 m/s² PHYSICS   CANNON-ES RENDERING   THREE.JS

Use the controls to adjust the launch angle, velocity, height, and mass of the ball.

When a new launch height is set, to launch, click RESET and immediately click LAUNCH.

Click SIMULATE button to begin the simulation.

(You can zoom and rotate the whole scene.)
